sources.note: Main marketing site. Describes WebChart as 'the minimally invasive EHR' for ambulatory practices. Lists core features: clinical documentation, patient portal, telehealth, RCM, clinical decision support, LMS, reporting. Claims 300+ vendor integrations. Lists specialties served including primary care, cardiology, ortho, OB/GYN, behavioral health, occupational health.

Comprehensive product documentation site with detailed table of contents. Reveals extensive module inventory: encounters, document management, DICOM imaging, scheduling, e-prescribing/EPCS, order management, injection/immunization tracking, case management, health surveillance, occupational health programs, dictation/transcription, quality reporting, portal management, e-signature, task management, data migration tools, asset management, and system administration. Key source for understanding full product capabilities.

Document management feature details including scanning, faxing, DICOM imaging, print definitions. Confirms support for TIFFs, web scanning with barcode indexing, inbound fax queue, DICOM viewer/MWL/CD burning.

MIE corporate 'About' page. Founded 1995 in Fort Wayne, Indiana. Five solution areas: Employee Health, Ambulatory Medicine, Patient Engagement, Health Information Exchange, Purpose-Built Solutions. Serves hospitals/health systems, physician practices, Fortune 500 employers, government agencies, consumers. Led by founder/CEO Doug Horner.

Enterprise Health product site — MIE's occupational/employee health platform built on WebChart. Comprehensive occ health software for corporations, health systems, government, universities, and third-party occ med providers. Features health surveillance, injury/illness management, regulatory compliance, immunizations, pre-employment exams, clinical care. Includes Ozwell AI integration.

April 2024 Serent Capital investment announcement. MIE described as 'leading provider of health IT software for the occupational health market.' Company grew ~40% annually over prior 6 years. Near-100% client retention rate. Investment to expand Enterprise Health platform. Could not fetch full text due to timeout but details confirmed via multiple secondary sources.
Serent Capital version of investment announcement. Serent has $5B AUM, partnered with 60+ founder-led companies, invested in 27+ healthcare tech companies.

FindEMR profile for WebChart. Pricing starts at $350/month. Key features: clinical decision support, lab results/flowsheets, e-prescribing, scheduling, billing, patient portal, document management, compliance tracking. Pros: flexible/customizable. Cons: interface may seem dated. 0 user reviews available. Among first 18 certified EHRs.

Article featuring physician testimonials about WebChart adoption. Dr. Beyer (efficiency/time savings), Dr. Alexander (customization), Dr. Dickins (flexibility), Dr. Mirro (incremental adoption). Highlights web-based access, customizable workflows, e-prescribing, point-and-click exams, modular implementation, paperless operations, interoperability (ACC PINNACLE Registry).

Concentra (major occupational health provider) deployed MIE's WebChart Enterprise Health at worksite health centers (~2010). Selected MIE for occupational/primary health IT expertise and SaaS model. Employee portal access for pre-visit health information. URL returned 404 but details confirmed via search snippet.
